name: Cossack Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet much wider than your shoulders and your toes turned slightly out, hands clasped at your chest.
Shift your weight to one side and squat down on that leg, keeping the other leg straight with the toes up.
Go as deep as you can with your heel on the floor.
Push back up and shift to the other side.
image_prompt_scene: In a wide stance with the toes slightly out and the hands clasped at the chest.
